load_model_from_zoo: load a pretrained DIHT vision-language model by name with its tokenizer and image transform
list_available_models: list all available pretrained model names from the DIHT model zoo config directory
download_model_checkpoint: download a model checkpoint from a URL with SHA256 checksum verification and progress bar
load_checkpoint_into_model: load a PyTorch checkpoint state dict into an existing model instance
extract_sha_from_url: extract the SHA256 hash string embedded in a model checkpoint download URL
